title: Weapons
doc: Every weapon and projectile: models, first person animations, ammunition, damage, sounds and effects.

sections.name: #Primary Weapons
sections.doc: Weapons listed first; each entry starts at $Name: and the list ends at #End.

fields.name: $Name:
fields.doc: Unique weapon name that other tables and levels use to refer to this weapon.

fields.name: $Display Name:
fields.doc: Localised name shown in the interface, written as XSTR(id, "text").

fields.name: $V3D Filename:
fields.doc: Projectile model (.v3d/.v3m or .vfx); "" draws no projectile.

fields.name: $Flags:
fields.doc: Weapon behaviour flags; an unknown flag name stops the game.

fields.name: $Flags2:
fields.doc: More weapon behaviour flags.

fields.name: $Cycle Position:
fields.doc: Slot of this player weapon in the weapon cycle; required (and unique) when $Flags has player_wep, not allowed otherwise.

fields.name: $Pref Position:
fields.doc: Auto-switch preference of this player weapon (0 is best); required (and unique) when $Flags has player_wep, not allowed otherwise.

fields.name: $Fine Aim Region Size:
fields.doc: Size of the fine aiming window as a fraction of the screen; required for player weapons.

fields.name: $Fine Aim Region Size SS:
fields.doc: Fine aiming window size used in split screen; required for player weapons.

fields.name: $Weapon Type:

children.name: $Weapon Icon:
children.doc: Icon bitmap used by the weapon switching interface; required after $Weapon Type, may be "".

fields.doc: Weapon switching category; other text is silently treated as no category.

fields.name: $Damage Type:
fields.doc: Kind of damage the weapon deals.

fields.name: $3rd Person V3D:
fields.doc: Model held by characters in third person.

fields.name: $3rd Person Muzzle Flash Glare:
fields.doc: Glare effect shown at the muzzle in third person.

fields.name: $1st Person Mesh:

children.name: $1st person FOV:
children.doc: Field of view for drawing the first person weapon.

children.name: $Splitscreen FOV:
children.doc: First person field of view in split screen.

children.name: $1st Person offset:
children.doc: Offset of the first person weapon from the eye.

children.name: $1st Person offset SS:
children.doc: First person weapon offset in split screen.

fields.doc: First person weapon model; the view fields below are read only after it.

fields.name: $1st person muzzle flash bitmap:

children.name: $1st person muzzle flash radius:
children.doc: Radius of the first person muzzle flash bitmap.

fields.doc: Muzzle flash bitmap seen in first person.

fields.name: $1st person alt muzzle flash bitmap:

children.name: $1st person alt muzzle flash radius:
children.doc: Radius of the alternate fire muzzle flash bitmap.

fields.doc: Muzzle flash bitmap for alternate fire in first person.

fields.name: $Silencer V3D:
fields.doc: Silencer model attached to the first person weapon.

fields.name: $Spark VFX:
fields.doc: Spark effect shown on the first person weapon (riot stick).

fields.name: +State:
fields.doc: First person looping animation: state name, then animation file.

fields.name: +Action:
fields.doc: First person one-shot animation: action name, animation file, foley played with it.

fields.name: $Bitmap Filename:

children.name: $Head Radius:
children.doc: Radius of the projectile bitmap head; only read when a bitmap is named.

children.name: +Length:
children.doc: Length of the projectile streak.

children.name: +Tail Radius:
children.doc: Radius of the streak tail; required after +Length.

fields.doc: Bitmap drawn for the projectile (a .vbm animates); "" for none, and then the radius fields are left out.

fields.name: $HUD Icon Filename:
fields.doc: Icon used on the HUD for this weapon.

fields.name: $HUD Reticle Filename:
fields.doc: Reticle bitmap.

fields.name: $HUD Zoomed Reticle Filename:
fields.doc: Reticle bitmap while zoomed.

fields.name: $HUD Locked Reticle Filename:
fields.doc: Reticle bitmap shown once the weapon has a lock.

fields.name: $PS2 Selection Icon Filemame:
fields.doc: Weapon select icon of the console version (the marker really is spelled Filemame).

fields.name: $Collision Radius:
fields.doc: Projectile collision radius.

fields.name: $Max Ammo:
fields.doc: Most ammunition the player can carry: single player, then multiplayer.

fields.name: $Ammo Type:
fields.doc: Ammunition this weapon uses (an ammo.tbl name).

fields.name: $AI Attack Range:
fields.doc: Distance AI tries to keep when attacking: single player, then multiplayer.

fields.name: $Clip Size:
fields.doc: Rounds per clip: single player, then multiplayer.

fields.name: $Clip Reload Time:
fields.doc: Seconds to reload a clip.

fields.name: $Clip Drain Time:
fields.doc: Seconds for a power weapon to drain a clip.

fields.name: $Mass:
fields.doc: Projectile mass.

fields.name: $Velocity:
fields.doc: Projectile speed.

fields.name: $Velocity Multi:
fields.doc: Projectile speed in multiplayer; defaults to $Velocity.

fields.name: $Fire Wait:
fields.doc: Seconds between shots.

fields.name: $Alt Fire Wait:
fields.doc: Seconds between alternate fire shots.

fields.name: $Num Projectiles:
fields.doc: Projectiles per shot.

fields.name: $Spread Degrees:
fields.doc: Random spread of shots.

fields.name: $Spread Degrees Multi:
fields.doc: Spread in multiplayer; defaults to $Spread Degrees.

fields.name: $AI Spread Degrees:
fields.doc: Spread when fired by AI: single player, then multiplayer.

fields.name: $Alt Spread Degrees:
fields.doc: Spread of alternate fire.

fields.name: $Alt Spread Degrees Multi:
fields.doc: Alternate fire spread in multiplayer.

fields.name: $AI Alt Spread Degrees:
fields.doc: Alternate fire spread for AI: single player, then multiplayer.

fields.name: $Start Sound:
fields.doc: Foley played when a continuous weapon spins up.

fields.name: $Start Delay:
fields.doc: Seconds between wanting to fire and firing.

fields.name: $Stop Sound:
fields.doc: Foley played when a continuous weapon winds down.

fields.name: $Burst Mode:

children.name: +Burst Count:
children.doc: Shots per burst.

children.name: +Burst Delay:
children.doc: Seconds between shots of a burst.

children.name: +Burst Launch Sound:

parts.doc: sound file name; "" means none (then nothing else follows)
minimum distance in metres (only when a file is given)
volume scale (only when a file is given)

children.doc: Sound for each burst shot: file, minimum distance, volume.

children.name: +Burst Alt Fire:
children.doc: Whether alternate fire also bursts.

fields.doc: Whether the weapon fires in bursts; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Damage:
fields.doc: Damage per hit in single player.

fields.name: $Damage Multi:
fields.doc: Damage per hit in multiplayer; defaults to $Damage.

fields.name: $Alt Damage:
fields.doc: Alternate fire damage in single player.

fields.name: $Alt Damage Multi:
fields.doc: Alternate fire damage in multiplayer.

fields.name: $AI Damage Scale:
fields.doc: Damage factor when fired by AI: single player, then multiplayer.

fields.name: $Lifetime:
fields.doc: Seconds the projectile lives.

fields.name: $Lifetime Multi:
fields.doc: Projectile lifetime in multiplayer.

fields.name: $Homing:

children.name: +Turn Time:
children.doc: How fast the projectile turns (lower turns quicker).

children.name: +View Cone:
children.doc: Field of view of the seeker.

children.name: +Scanning Range:
children.doc: How far ahead the seeker looks.

children.name: +Wakeup Time:
children.doc: Seconds before the seeker starts tracking.

fields.doc: Whether the projectile homes in; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Launch:
fields.doc: Foley played when the weapon fires; may be "".

fields.name: $Alt Launch:
fields.doc: Foley played on alternate fire.

fields.name: $Silent Launch:
fields.doc: Foley played when fired with a silencer.

fields.name: $Underwater Launch:
fields.doc: Foley played when fired underwater.

fields.name: $Launch Fail:
fields.doc: Foley played when the weapon cannot fire.

fields.name: $Fly Sound:

parts.doc: sound file name; "" means none (then nothing else follows)
minimum distance in metres (only when a file is given)
volume scale (only when a file is given)

fields.doc: Looping sound of the projectile in flight: file, minimum distance, volume; may be "".

fields.name: $Zoom Sound:

parts.doc: sound file name; "" means none (then nothing else follows)
minimum distance in metres (only when a file is given)
volume scale (only when a file is given)

fields.doc: Sound played when zooming: file, minimum distance, volume.

fields.name: $Impact Delay:
fields.doc: Seconds before melee damage or projectile creation; at most two lines (single player, multiplayer).

fields.name: $Alt Impact Delay:
fields.doc: Impact delay for alternate fire; at most two lines.

fields.name: $Impact Sound:
fields.doc: Foley played on impact with a material: material name (or "underwater"), then foley name.

fields.name: $Near Miss Sound:
fields.doc: Foley for near misses.

fields.name: $Near Miss Underwater:
fields.doc: Foley for near misses underwater.

fields.name: $Geomod Sound:
fields.doc: Foley played when the weapon makes a geomod crater.

fields.name: $Impact Vclips:
fields.doc: Up to three vclips played on impact; ("") for none.

fields.name: $Impact Vclips Radius:
fields.doc: Radius of each impact vclip.

fields.name: $Impact Decal:
fields.doc: Decal left on impact: bitmap, then two sizes.

fields.name: $Trail emitter:
fields.doc: Particle emitter that trails the projectile.

fields.name: $Damage Radius:
fields.doc: Splash damage radius in single player.

fields.name: $Damage Radius Multi:
fields.doc: Splash damage radius in multiplayer.

fields.name: +Crater Radius:
fields.doc: Geomod crater radius.

fields.name: $Sticky:

children.name: +Stick Sound:

parts.doc: sound file name; "" means none (then nothing else follows)
minimum distance in metres (only when a file is given)
volume scale (only when a file is given)

children.doc: Sound when sticking to a material: material, then sound file, minimum distance, volume.

children.name: +Embedded V3D Filename:
children.doc: Model shown while stuck.

fields.doc: Whether the projectile sticks to what it hits; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Glow:

children.name: +Inner Radius:
children.doc: Radius where the light is at full strength.

children.name: +Outer Radius:
children.doc: Radius where the light has faded out.

children.name: +Color:
children.doc: Light colour as {r, g, b} or {r, g, b, a}, components 0 to 255.

fields.doc: Whether the projectile casts light; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Muzzle Flash Light:

children.name: +Inner Radius:
children.doc: Radius where the light is at full strength.

children.name: +Outer Radius:
children.doc: Radius where the light has faded out.

children.name: +Color:
children.doc: Light colour as {r, g, b} or {r, g, b, a}, components 0 to 255.

fields.doc: Whether firing casts a muzzle light; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Drill Time:
fields.doc: Drill time.

fields.name: $Drill Range:
fields.doc: Drill reach.

fields.name: $Drill Charge:
fields.doc: Drill charge.

fields.name: $Scorch Bitmap:
fields.doc: Scorch decal bitmap.

fields.name: $Scorch Size:
fields.doc: Scorch decal size.

fields.name: $Glass Decal Bitmap:
fields.doc: Decal bitmap left on glass.

fields.name: $Glass Decal Size:
fields.doc: Glass decal size.

fields.name: $Shells Ejected:

children.name: +V3D:
children.doc: Shell model.

children.name: +Base Dir:
children.doc: Ejection direction.

children.name: +Eject Velocity:
children.doc: Ejection speed.

children.name: +Custom Sound Set:
children.doc: Impact sound set used when the shell lands.

children.name: +Primary Pause Time Before Eject:
children.doc: Delay before the shell is ejected.

fields.doc: Marker without a value that starts the ejected shell description.

fields.name: $Clips Ejected:

children.name: +V3D:
children.doc: Clip model.

children.name: +Drop Pause Time:
children.doc: Delay before the clip drops.

children.name: +Custom Sound Set:
children.doc: Impact sound set used when the clip lands.

fields.doc: Marker without a value that starts the dropped clip description.

fields.name: $Camera Shake:

children.name: +Distance:
children.doc: Shake amount.

children.name: +Time:
children.doc: Shake duration.

fields.doc: Marker without a value that starts the camera shake description.

fields.name: $Tracers:

children.name: +Tracer Frequency:
children.doc: Rounds fired between tracers.

children.name: +Tracer Effect:
children.doc: Effect or model used for the tracer.

fields.doc: Whether the weapon fires tracers; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Piercing:

children.name: +Piercing Power:
children.doc: Mass the shot can pierce before stopping.

children.name: +Ricochet Angle:
children.doc: Angle at which shots ricochet instead of piercing.

children.name: +Ricochet Bitmap:
children.doc: Ricochet decal bitmap.

children.name: +Ricochet Size:
children.doc: Ricochet decal size.

fields.doc: Whether shots pierce geometry; the + fields follow only when true.

fields.name: $Thrust Lifetime:
fields.doc: Seconds the projectile thruster burns.

fields.name: $Reload Zero Drain:
fields.doc: Seconds into a reload after which the current clip empties.

fields.name: $Multi BBox Size Factor:
fields.doc: Hit box scale in multiplayer.
